CHECK TO BE PERFORMED

RESOLUTION IF THE CHECK IS NOT OK

1

Remove the headlamp

Op. 5540B81 LEFT GAS DISCHARGE LIGHT CLUSTER - R.R.

Disconnect the control unit from the headlamp

Op. 5540B40 CONTROL UNIT IN LEFT GAS DISCHARGE LIGHT CLUSTER - R.R.

Connect the diagnostic tester in ohmmeter mode and check the continuity between Pin 10 of the headlamp 14-way connector

See F010 LEFT HEADLAMP

and pin 15 of the control unit connector

Replace the headlamp

2

Replace the Ballast control unit

Op. 5540B40 CONTROL UNIT IN LEFT GAS DISCHARGE LIGHT CLUSTER - R.R.

A - Electrical connector

B - Shielded cable
